energy.note: Rule ration is abstract mixed food; calories and grain density absent books. Do not equate 0.5kg rule ration to 0.5kg cereal.

size_requirements.note: Pick water convention explicitly; giant adult Huge normally16 M food units, not1. Powerful Build alone does not change body size.

goodberry.note: Literal creature nourishment no size limit; assigning berry to Huge giant nourishes one giant-day. Calories realized depend beneficiary. No blanket innate halfling/elf Goodberry found.

create_food_water.note: Explicit15humanoid/5mount cap; giant creature type is not humanoid. Material created food can be allocated physically as P but do not promise15giants by rule cap.

plant_growth.note: Overlap accounted as union. Same spell repeated not exponentiated. Existing vegetation/cultivation necessary.

pakaitos_recovery.note: Highest-level slot, not arbitrary lowest slot. Recovery requires actual available short rest; no unlimited productivity assumption.

acolyte.note: Statblock spells prepared do not include food production.

druid.note: Cannot Plant Growth. Changing prepared spell Goodberry is explicit D/P variant.

full_caster5.note: Reserve P1 level1slot forGoodberry, P1 level3slot forCFW orGrowth; spare slots remain care/security.

service_budget.note: 120unserved days need ordinary foods or rotated caster contracts. PlantGrowth days use8h plus slot. For person-qualified multiple spells, one slot/time ledger prevents duplication.

allocation.method: Assign individual people to disjoint service pools, max cohort=min(rateCap*N, candidate occupation count times chosen qualified fraction). Show qualified fraction and level distribution separately. If pool sums exceed physical candidates, shrink until feasible.
